profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MK Tech
profile.summary:
Specialties: Enterprise Software Systems, Spring Boot, Java, Python, Django, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PHP, JQuery, SQL Queries, Git, Docker, Agile Development Methodologies, AWS Infrastructure
Provisioning, AWS Automation & Scripting, AWS Monitoring & Logging

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Passport Testing Application

Developed a passport authenticity application using Java/Angular on AWS (IAM, EC2, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, S3, RDS) and Agile workflows via Jira.

Applicant Tracking Application

Developed, deployed, and maintained an enterprise applicant tracking system using a Java/Angular tech stack on AWS Cloud infrastructure (IAM, EC2, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, S3, RDS) with Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. The application serves 100,000+ enterprise users, with support operations managed through a customized ticketing system and Agile workflows via Jira.

Image Management System

Developed, deployed, and maintained a custom image management system using a Python/Django tech stack on AWS Cloud infrastructure. Independently architected and managed full AWS service stack including IAM, EC2, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, S3, and RDS as a small, autonomous development team. The team owned the complete development lifecycle from integration through testing and deployment, following Agile methodologies with project tracking via Jira.

Web Image Generator UI

Independently developed and maintained AI image generation application using a Python/Django/CUDA tech stack on AWS Cloud infrastructure. Architected a GPU-accelerated solution running on AWS EC2 GPU instances with Dockerized image generation processes built by the Data Science team. Leveraged AWS services including IAM, EC2, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and S3 for scalable image storage and management. Owned the complete development lifecycle from feature design through testing and deployment, following Agile methodologies with project tracking via Jira.

Python Image Generator UI

Developed a desktop application using Python/PySide6 for GPU-enabled Windows workstations, integrating Dockerized image generation processes from the Data Science team. Packaged and deployed the application using PyInstaller for local execution on enterprise workstations.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Web Engineering · Software Industry

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Sales I.T. Support

Part of the Sales Development team managing two sales applications that enable prompt and accurate data to flow through the sales business systems, a Point of Sales (POS) Portal and Model N.  The former is built using JQuery for the UI, Java / Spring / Hibernate for the middle tier and Oracle PL/SQL for the data layer.  Additional responsibilities include building custom reports in SQL out of the Model N data set for the sales group.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work Tracking System

Developer on a Ruby on Rails (RoR) system built for tracking work & tasks that are delegated to other organizations within the enterprise.  Full system stack is an Oracle 11g database, Ruby on Rails middle tier, Solr search indexing and a JQuery/Bootstrap UI.  The RoR code runs on a Linux, CentOS operating system and is deployed to a Passenger web container then made available to the end users from the latest Apache web server.  Authentication & authorization of end users is done through the use of X509 certificates.

Transitioned/maintained CentOS servers into AWS.  Previous environment was a set of Hypervisor provisioned virtual servers running behind a virtual load balancer.  AWS environment runs servers in a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) inside which are two Availability Zones (AZ).  Each AZ contains a set of three Elastic Cloud Compute (EC2) instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB).  Authorization is handled by AWS Security Groups, monitoring is handled by CloudWatch and application auditing is handled by CloudTrail.  Backup and Recovery is done through a set of scripts that spin up fully verified server snapshots.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Crowd-funding Web Application

Developer on a WordPress CMS application built to attract project advocates with funds to a centralized, online, enterprise system where users can discover, collaborate and support new initiatives.  System was implemented as a WordPress v4.1 application utilizing the CMB2 plugin and elements of the Fundler theme.  It uses an Apache 2.4 server, runs on an EC2 instance and persists the data to a MySQL v5 database running on an RDS database instance.

Gamification Web Service

Developer on a Ruby on Rails enterprise service built to encourage user engagement of other systems by rewarding them for interacting online.  The system had an admin console for project managers enabling them to configure their gamification rules and a RESTful service interface that handled the communication of the game mechanics to/from adopting systems.  Implemented in Ruby 2.2 and Rails 4.2, the application used Apache 2.4 as the web server, Passenger v5.4 as the application server, ran on an EC2 instance and persisted the data to a MySQL v5 database running on an RDS database instance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Provisioning Application

Transitioned/maintained/troubleshot/updated a Ruby on Rails (RoR), corporate, provisioning system running Rails 3.0.10 and Ruby 1.8.7 that persisted data through a secure SSL connection to an Oracle 11g database.  The web-based application’s presentation layer, built using a combination of Embedded Ruby Templates (ERBs) and JQuery, tracked user credentials for customers by coalescing data from authoritative peers then filtering the data before distributing it in an XML and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) format.  The application used a combination of Delayed Job queues running as Cron jobs to send batched data to requesting authorities in FIFO order and via on-demand RESTful services.

Transitioning/Updating duties included re-architecting the Solaris version of the application to run on Scientific Linux.  The new environment required conversion of the Shell and Capistrano scripts, adaption & upgrading of the Apache/Passenger configuration and determining an efficient strategy for upgrading Rails and Ruby.

Maintenance/Troubleshooting duties included daily checks of peer connections and services, reconciliation of stale data, development of new features, integration of corporate policy changes and database management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Multi-informational Web Portal

Web portal developer implementing follow-on features using Ruby on Rails (RoR) on the server side and the JQuery JavaScript framework on the client side.  Portal application runs on a Linux OS, uses an Apache web server, and data is persisted to a MySQL database.

Andriod Device Reader

Android developer implementing proprietary, enterprise applications using Android Development Tools (ADT) to build a document reader for Ice Cream Sandwich.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Credit Card Issuing System

Developer on an enterprise web application that tracks and manages corporate credit cards.  The Struts layer routes HTTP requests for the card purchasing system and the Spring MVC layer routes HTTP requests for the travel card system.  Servlets filter requests received from the Struts/Spring MVC layer directing them through to the service delegate layer to the Hibernate layer which manages the Oracle database transactions.
- Responsible for managing, maintaining and updating the application.
- Assisted in successfully porting the web application from Weblogic to Tomcat.

Nextgen Credit Card Issuing System

Developer on a next-generation, corporate, financial management system using Ruby on Rails (RoR) on the server side and Ext JS 4.0 on the client side.  Management system runs on a Linux OS and uses an Apache web server.  The production environment persists data to an Oracle database.  The development and test environments persist data to a MySQL database.

positions.title: Senior Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
Information Security Web Site

Developer on an enterprise web application allowing IT projects in other parts of the enterprise to track their application's progress through the certification process.
- Implemented as a JEE application
- Used JSP, ExtJS and POJO Factories
- Used DAOs for SQL Server database transactions

Audio Video Information System

Managed, maintained, updated and upgraded a multimedia web application that creates archives and retrieves multimedia files. Recordings utilized the Cocoon framework to display web interface, Java and native Windows code in the middle-tier to collect multimedia packets, an Oracle 11g database to store file metadata and HP storage technology to store the completed media files.
- Troubleshot and supported 150 end-users.
- Was responsible for entire system, front to back.

COPAN File Archiver

Was responsible for the COPAN File Archiver pilot study and its subsequent installation.  The storage unit ran its own proprietary archiving and retrieving application on a rudimentary - Linux SuSE 10.3 operating system.
- Verified the feasibility of using a COPAN File Archiver appliance to archive media files rather than saving them to DVD disk.
- Coordinated hardware and software setup of COPAN appliance.
- Built shell and Perl scripts to redirect archival and retrieval of multimedia files from DVD disk to the COPAN File Archiver.

Audio Video Information System Technology Upgrade

Upgraded server operating system from Windows Server 2000 to Windows Server 2008 as well as Oracle database from 9i to 11g.
- Installed and reconfigured Audio Video Information System application for new OS environment.
- Worked with DBA to upgrade Oracle database version.
- Supervised re-architecture of old Audio Video Information System database for interoperability with updated corporate infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Web Portal Application

Developer on an incident reporting web application that used a JSP and JSTL front end, a POJO delegate layer, a POJO DAO layer and an Oracle 10g database.  Four months into development cycle, DAOs carrying out CRUD transactions were replaced with Spring JDBC.

Intranet Document Repository

Developer on a document creation, storage and retrieval system that used a standard JSP and Struts presentation-layer, a delegate middle-tier and POJO DAOs for Oracle 10g transactions; was part of full project life-cycle.

U.S. Air Force (USAF) Information Network Application

Developer on a web-based airplane asset-tracking system, accessible from the main USAF web-portal allowing base and field personnel to identify, locate and order required parts for airplane maintenance; was the main parts inventory tracking system for all USAF airplane parts.
- Responsible for providing Oracle MVC Framework implementation expertise, training and mentoring of other developers at Maxwell Air Force Base.
- Involved during the testing phase only when the application began malfunctioning.
- Successfully resolved application issues and implemented required updates.

Management Reporting Tool

Developer on tool enabling users to search, edit, update, save and submit their weekly statuses to an approving authority.  Status-data was saved based on a unique user-id while the approvers were managed in a hierarchical tree structure within an EJB logic tier.

Oracle Training: Attended Oracle training courses.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer on a bit-stream parser for a communications network.
- Articulated the project requirements in Rational Rose.
- Implemented static constant files for subsystem.

Developer/Tester on a software communications simulator.
- Built communications simulator XML descriptor files using an in-house XML generator.
- Developed and tested communications simulator using Ada, C and C++ running on an SGI Onyx2 under an IRIX OS.

Developer on a team responsible for gathering requirements and determining specifications for the International Simulator for the Joint Strike Fighter (JSF International).

Supervised and completed the setup of a flight simulation lab intended for use as a flight simulation software development facility for JSF International.
- Lab setup responsibilities:
- - Interfacing with customer to gather lab equipment and software requirements
- - Purchase of necessary equipment and software
- - Coordinating the installation and configuration of lab equipment and operation systems
- Simulation lab technology:
- - Silicon Graphics Octane-2 workstations running IRIX v6.5.18 O.S.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Online Tire Ordering Site

Assisted in building an online shopping site for Discount Tire Company developed using Java and Jakarta Project technologies.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
E-Commerce Web Site

Software development of an E-Commerce, Business-to-Business web interface using Java technologies such as Java Server Pages (JSPs), Servlets, and Java Beans
·	Phase I was developed under an Inprise and JRun environment on Windows
·	Phase II was developed under a Weblogic Application/Web Server environment on Windows
·	Implemented the web interface using the Servlet-Centric design pattern, which separates the business logic by the use of a controlling servlet and Java Beans using JSPs
·	The web interface communicated with the Oracle database through a set of existing APIs
·	Assisted with the design/implementation for the final release of the web interface by applying the Refactoring technique using JUnit for Java component testing.

Web Translation Tool

Participated in a Java web translation tool that translated input in one language to another; European languages as well as those of the Orient such as Japanese and Chinese.  We used a SQL Server 7.0 database to store the letters and phrases of each language, Atinav's aveConnect to translate the SQL Server character set into the UTF-8 character set then, implementing the translation logic using the MVC design pattern, displayed the letter(s) or phrase(s) in a web browser.  The application ran in both Netscape 4 and Internet Explorer 4.0 browsers.

positions.title: Associate Applications Software Engineer
positions.description:
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) System

Software developer for a SAR system intended for use on F16 jets.  Built part of the Payload Controller software module in C++ which was a real time controller system running under VxWorks and using RogueWave libraries and the GreenHills cross compiler.

Management of Project Requirements

Management of project requirements database using the Requirements Traceability Management (RTM) tool.
Responsible for development of a test routine for the Gimbal System developed in C/C++ for a VxWorks OS 
running on a MC680x0 board which will communicate with the Payload Controller software module via RS-232 
serial port.

Electronic Warfare Management System (EWMS) Simulator

Responsible for development of an Electronic Warfare Management System (EWMS) simulator in C++ under a UNIX environment running two processes communicating via RS-232 serial port.

Simulator GUI

Assisted in development of a GUI in Java using JDeveloper intended to be a JDBC front end for user access over the Lockheed intranet.  The GUI was a Java 2 JApplet running in a Netscape browser built out of a series of JTextAreas and JComboBoxes set on JTabbedPanes and JScrollPanes, which were set on JPanels.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant III
positions.description:
Support of Computer Lab

Administration and support of x86 multimedia PCs, installation and maintenance of language learning applications on PCs, training of students and professors, operation of specialized equipment for distributing video and audio from instructor's demonstration computer to multiple PC displays, operation of a media management system for distributing video to media capable classrooms, training of users in email access, the UNIX shell and web page development.

Received letter of commendation from A.S.U. President Lattie F. Coor for my performance.

courses.name: Pragmatic Studio's Ruby on Rails Studio

volunteerExperiences.description: Was responsible for keeping the records for patients in the Hospice up to date and helping with United Way fund raiser preparations.

Crowd-funding Web Application

Developer on a WordPress CMS application built to attract project advocates with funds to a centralized, online, enterprise system where users can discover, collaborate and support new initiatives.  System was implemented as a WordPress v4.1 application utilizing the CMB2 plugin and elements of the Fundler theme.  It uses an Apache 2.4 server, runs on an EC2 instance and persists the data to a MySQL v5 database running on an RDS database instance.

Gamification Web Service

Developer on a Ruby on Rails enterprise service built to encourage user engagement of other systems by rewarding them for interacting online.  The system had an admin console for project managers enabling them to configure their gamification rules and a RESTful service interface that handled the communication of the game mechanics to/from adopting systems.  Implemented in Ruby 2.2 and Rails 4.2, the application used Apache 2.4 as the web server, Passenger v5.4 as the application server, ran on an EC2 instance and persisted the data to a MySQL v5 database running on an RDS database instance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Provisioning Application

Transitioned/maintained/troubleshot/updated a Ruby on Rails (RoR), corporate, provisioning system running Rails 3.0.10 and Ruby 1.8.7 that persisted data through a secure SSL connection to an Oracle 11g database.  The web-based application’s presentation layer, built using a combination of Embedded Ruby Templates (ERBs) and JQuery, tracked user credentials for customers by coalescing data from authoritative peers then filtering the data before distributing it in an XML and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) format.  The application used a combination of Delayed Job queues running as Cron jobs to send batched data to requesting authorities in FIFO order and via on-demand RESTful services.

Transitioning/Updating duties included re-architecting the Solaris version of the application to run on Scientific Linux.  The new environment required conversion of the Shell and Capistrano scripts, adaption & upgrading of the Apache/Passenger configuration and determining an efficient strategy for upgrading Rails and Ruby.

Maintenance/Troubleshooting duties included daily checks of peer connections and services, reconciliation of stale data, development of new features, integration of corporate policy changes and database management.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Multi-informational Web Portal

Web portal developer implementing follow-on features using Ruby on Rails (RoR) on the server side and the JQuery JavaScript framework on the client side.  Portal application runs on a Linux OS, uses an Apache web server, and data is persisted to a MySQL database.

Andriod Device Reader

Android developer implementing proprietary, enterprise applications using Android Development Tools (ADT) to build a document reader for Ice Cream Sandwich.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Credit Card Issuing System

Developer on an enterprise web application that tracks and manages corporate credit cards.  The Struts layer routes HTTP requests for the card purchasing system and the Spring MVC layer routes HTTP requests for the travel card system.  Servlets filter requests received from the Struts/Spring MVC layer directing them through to the service delegate layer to the Hibernate layer which manages the Oracle database transactions.
- Responsible for managing, maintaining and updating the application.
- Assisted in successfully porting the web application from Weblogic to Tomcat.

Nextgen Credit Card Issuing System

Developer on a next-generation, corporate, financial management system using Ruby on Rails (RoR) on the server side and Ext JS 4.0 on the client side.  Management system runs on a Linux OS and uses an Apache web server.  The production environment persists data to an Oracle database.  The development and test environments persist data to a MySQL database.

experience.title: Senior Principle Software Engineer
experience.description:
Information Security Web Site

Developer on an enterprise web application allowing IT projects in other parts of the enterprise to track their application's progress through the certification process.
- Implemented as a JEE application
- Used JSP, ExtJS and POJO Factories
- Used DAOs for SQL Server database transactions

Audio Video Information System

Managed, maintained, updated and upgraded a multimedia web application that creates archives and retrieves multimedia files. Recordings utilized the Cocoon framework to display web interface, Java and native Windows code in the middle-tier to collect multimedia packets, an Oracle 11g database to store file metadata and HP storage technology to store the completed media files.
- Troubleshot and supported 150 end-users.
- Was responsible for entire system, front to back.

COPAN File Archiver

Was responsible for the COPAN File Archiver pilot study and its subsequent installation.  The storage unit ran its own proprietary archiving and retrieving application on a rudimentary - Linux SuSE 10.3 operating system.
- Verified the feasibility of using a COPAN File Archiver appliance to archive media files rather than saving them to DVD disk.
- Coordinated hardware and software setup of COPAN appliance.
- Built shell and Perl scripts to redirect archival and retrieval of multimedia files from DVD disk to the COPAN File Archiver.

Audio Video Information System Technology Upgrade

Upgraded server operating system from Windows Server 2000 to Windows Server 2008 as well as Oracle database from 9i to 11g.
- Installed and reconfigured Audio Video Information System application for new OS environment.
- Worked with DBA to upgrade Oracle database version.
- Supervised re-architecture of old Audio Video Information System database for interoperability with updated corporate infrastructure.

experience.title: Senior Consultant
experience.description:
Web Portal Application

Developer on an incident reporting web application that used a JSP and JSTL front end, a POJO delegate layer, a POJO DAO layer and an Oracle 10g database.  Four months into development cycle, DAOs carrying out CRUD transactions were replaced with Spring JDBC.

Intranet Document Repository

Developer on a document creation, storage and retrieval system that used a standard JSP and Struts presentation-layer, a delegate middle-tier and POJO DAOs for Oracle 10g transactions; was part of full project life-cycle.

U.S. Air Force (USAF) Information Network Application

Developer on a web-based airplane asset-tracking system, accessible from the main USAF web-portal allowing base and field personnel to identify, locate and order required parts for airplane maintenance; was the main parts inventory tracking system for all USAF airplane parts.
- Responsible for providing Oracle MVC Framework implementation expertise, training and mentoring of other developers at Maxwell Air Force Base.
- Involved during the testing phase only when the application began malfunctioning.
- Successfully resolved application issues and implemented required updates.

Management Reporting Tool

Developer on tool enabling users to search, edit, update, save and submit their weekly statuses to an approving authority.  Status-data was saved based on a unique user-id while the approvers were managed in a hierarchical tree structure within an EJB logic tier.

Oracle Training: Attended Oracle training courses.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Developer on a bit-stream parser for a communications network.
- Articulated the project requirements in Rational Rose.
- Implemented static constant files for subsystem.

Developer/Tester on a software communications simulator.
- Built communications simulator XML descriptor files using an in-house XML generator.
- Developed and tested communications simulator using Ada, C and C++ running on an SGI Onyx2 under an IRIX OS.

Developer on a team responsible for gathering requirements and determining specifications for the International Simulator for the Joint Strike Fighter (JSF International).

Supervised and completed the setup of a flight simulation lab intended for use as a flight simulation software development facility for JSF International.
- Lab setup responsibilities:
- - Interfacing with customer to gather lab equipment and software requirements
- - Purchase of necessary equipment and software
- - Coordinating the installation and configuration of lab equipment and operation systems
- Simulation lab technology:
- - Silicon Graphics Octane-2 workstations running IRIX v6.5.18 O.S.

experience.title: Senior Consultant
experience.description:
Online Tire Ordering Site

Assisted in building an online shopping site for Discount Tire Company developed using Java and Jakarta Project technologies.

experience.title: Senior Consultant
experience.description:
E-Commerce Web Site

Software development of an E-Commerce, Business-to-Business web interface using Java technologies such as Java Server Pages (JSPs), Servlets, and Java Beans
·	Phase I was developed under an Inprise and JRun environment on Windows
·	Phase II was developed under a Weblogic Application/Web Server environment on Windows
·	Implemented the web interface using the Servlet-Centric design pattern, which separates the business logic by the use of a controlling servlet and Java Beans using JSPs
·	The web interface communicated with the Oracle database through a set of existing APIs
·	Assisted with the design/implementation for the final release of the web interface by applying the Refactoring technique using JUnit for Java component testing.

Web Translation Tool

Participated in a Java web translation tool that translated input in one language to another; European languages as well as those of the Orient such as Japanese and Chinese.  We used a SQL Server 7.0 database to store the letters and phrases of each language, Atinav's aveConnect to translate the SQL Server character set into the UTF-8 character set then, implementing the translation logic using the MVC design pattern, displayed the letter(s) or phrase(s) in a web browser.  The application ran in both Netscape 4 and Internet Explorer 4.0 browsers.

experience.title: Associate Applications Software Engineer
experience.description:
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) System

Software developer for a SAR system intended for use on F16 jets.  Built part of the Payload Controller software module in C++ which was a real time controller system running under VxWorks and using RogueWave libraries and the GreenHills cross compiler.

Management of Project Requirements

Management of project requirements database using the Requirements Traceability Management (RTM) tool.
Responsible for development of a test routine for the Gimbal System developed in C/C++ for a VxWorks OS 
running on a MC680x0 board which will communicate with the Payload Controller software module via RS-232 
serial port.

Electronic Warfare Management System (EWMS) Simulator

Responsible for development of an Electronic Warfare Management System (EWMS) simulator in C++ under a UNIX environment running two processes communicating via RS-232 serial port.

Simulator GUI

Assisted in development of a GUI in Java using JDeveloper intended to be a JDBC front end for user access over the Lockheed intranet.  The GUI was a Java 2 JApplet running in a Netscape browser built out of a series of JTextAreas and JComboBoxes set on JTabbedPanes and JScrollPanes, which were set on JPanels.

experience.title: Computer Lab Assistant III
experience.description:
Support of Computer Lab

Administration and support of x86 multimedia PCs, installation and maintenance of language learning applications on PCs, training of students and professors, operation of specialized equipment for distributing video and audio from instructor's demonstration computer to multiple PC displays, operation of a media management system for distributing video to media capable classrooms, training of users in email access, the UNIX shell and web page development.

Received letter of commendation from A.S.U. President Lattie F. Coor for my performance.
